pricing.title: Hlola amandla ka-Tracify nge
pricing.subtitle: I-Tracify inikeza amasevisi ayo ngokubhaliselwa kwanyanga nganyanga okulula ukuphatha.
pricing.trialDesc: I-Tracify isebenza ngokusekelwe kokubhaliselwa kwenyanga. Inkokhelo yakho yokuqala ikunika ukufinyelela okungenammingcele kuwo wonke amasevisi wenkundla amahora angu-24. Ngemva kwaleso sikhathi, imali yokubhaliselwa
pricing.subscriptionDesc: Uma isikhathi sokuhlola samahora angu-24 sesiphelile, isipesheli sizovuselelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo sibe ukubhaliselwa kwenyanga. Khumbula ukuthi ungakhansela ukubhaliselwa noma nini.

howItWorks.title: Kusebenza Kanjani?
howItWorks.step1Desc: Faka inombolo yocingo ofuna ukuyithola futhi wenze umlayezo we-SMS ofuna umamukeli awuthole.
howItWorks.step2Desc: I-Tracify izothumela umamukeli umlayezo wakho we-SMS oyobe ucela indawo yocingo.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Thola isaziso ngokushesha nje uma umamukeli evuma ukwabelana ngendawo yakhe. Buka indawo enqika emephini edeshibhodini lakho.

features.title: Kungani Ukhetha i-Tracify?
features.subtitle: Ukuchofoza okukodwa kanye nomzamo ongenalutho ukuthola indawo yanoma ubani emhlabeni wonke
features.feature1Desc: Nakuba umnikazi wocingo ezokwaziswa ngesicelo sendawo, ubunikazi bomceli sisala buyimfihlo. Zonke izicelo zendawo zenziwa ngokuhlonipha ubumfihlo, nedatha edluliswayo ibethelwe ukuphepha.
features.feature2Desc: Akukho software okufanele ifakwe kuocingo lwakho noma kudivayisi elihlosiwe. Konke kusebenza kude! Vele ufake inombolo yocingo ofuna ukulandelela. Ngokushesha nje umamukeli we-SMS enika imvume, uzoba nokufinyelela ngokushesha.
features.feature3Desc: I-Tracify isebenza namanethiwekhi wonke emhlabeni wonke. Nokho, ukulandelela okuphumelelayo kudinga ukuthi ucingo luvuliwe, ukutholakala kwesevisi, kanye nemvume ecacile yomamukeli we-SMS ukwabelana ngendawo yabo.
features.feature4Desc: I-Tracify isekela ngokungaphazamisi amadivayisi eselula i-iOS ne-Android. Uma nje unayo inombolo yocingo kanye nemvumo ecacile yomuntu wokulandelela, ungabathola usebenzisa isevisi yethu.

faq.title: Imibuzo Evamile
faq.subtitle: Lapha ungathola zonke izimpendulo zemibuzo esibuzwa kakhulu ngayo mayelana nesevisi yethu yendawo yeselula, i-Tracify.
faq.a1: I-Tracify iyisevisi yendawo yeselula ekuvumela ukuthola noma yiluphi inombolo yocingo emhlabeni wonke. Isevisi yethu isebenza ngokuthumela i-SMS kucingo elihlosiwe licela imvumo yokwabelana ngendawo. Uma imvumo inikeziwe, uthola izixhumanisi ze-GPS ezinembile.
faq.q2: Ingabe kusemthethweni ukusebenzisa ukulandelela inombolo yocingo kwe-Tracify?
faq.a2: Yebo, i-Tracify isemthethweni ngokuphelele ngoba idinga imvumo ecacile kumuntu olandelwayo. Umamukeli kumele avume ngokusebenzayo ukwabelana ngendawo yakhe ngokuphendula isicelo se-SMS. Sihambisana nazo zonke izimiso zobumfihlo nemithetho yokuvikela idatha.
faq.a3: I-Tracify isekela wonke amanethiwekhi amakhulu eselula emhlabeni wonke. Noma ucingo elihlosiwe lisebenzisa amanethiwekhi e-GSM, CDMA, LTE, noma 5G, isevisi yethu ingathume sela izicelo zendawo kunoma yiluphi inombolo yocingo evumelekile.
faq.q4: Ngingakulandelela yini indawo yenombolo yocingo uma ngingazi imodeli yayo?
faq.a4: Impela! Akudingeki ukwazi imodeli yocingo, umkhiqizi, noma uhlelo lokusebenza. Konke okudingayo yinombolo yocingo. Uhlelo lwethu liphatha ngokuzenzakalelayo zonke imininingwane yezobuchwepheshe kungakhathaliseki uhlobo lwedivayisi.
faq.q5: Ingabe i-Tracify isekela amadivayisi eselula e-iOS ne-Android?
faq.a5: Yebo, i-Tracify isebenza namadivayisi e-iOS (iPhone) ne-Android. Uhlelo lwethu lwesicelo sendawo olusekelwe ku-SMS luhambisana nanoma yiluphi i-smartphone engathole imilayezo yombhalo futhi inezinsizakalo zendawo ezitholakalayo.
faq.q6: I-Tracify ingathola ngokushesha kangakanani indawo yenombolo yocingo?
faq.a6: Uma umamukeli we-SMS evuma ukwabelana ngendawo yakhe, uzothola izixhumanisi cishe ngokushesha. Isikhathi esiphelele sincike ekutheni umamukeli uphendula ngokushesha kangakanani esicelo sendawo.
faq.q7: Ukulandelela kanjani inombolo yocingo ngaphandle kokufinyelela ngokoqobo kudivayisi elihlosiwe?
faq.a7: Vele ufake inombolo yocingo ohlelweni lwethu, wenze umlayezo wakho, bese sithumela i-SMS ecela imvumo yendawo. Konke kwenziwa kude - akudingeki ukufinyelela ngokoqobo kudivayisi elihlosiwe.
faq.a8: Yebo, kodwa kuphela ngemvumo yabo ecacile. I-Tracify ithumela isicelo sendawo nge-SMS, futhi ukulandelela kwenzeka kuphela uma umamukeli evuma ukwabelana ngendawo yakhe. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ubumfihlo nokuhambisana nomthetho.
faq.a9p1: Sinikeza isikhathi sokuhlola samahora angu-24 nge
faq.a9p2: , esikunika ukufinyelela okugcwele kuzo zonke izici. Ngemva kokuhlola, ungaqhubeka nokubhaliselwa kwethu kwenyanga nge
faq.a10: Uma unemibuzo enye noma udinga usizo, ungangabazi ukuxhumana nethimba lethu lokusekela. Silapha ukusiza wena 24/7. Ungasithinta ngekhasi lethu Lokusithinta noma usithumelele i-imeyli ngqo.

terms.title: Imibandela Nemibandela
terms.cardSubtitle: Sicela ufunde le mibandela ngokucophelela ngaphambi kokusebenzisa isevisi yethu.

introduction.title: 1. Isingeniso
introduction.content: Siyakwamukela ku-Tracify. Ngokufinyelela noma ukusebenzisa iwebhusayithi yethu ku-tracify-geo.com kanye namasevisi ethu okulandelela indawo yocingo, uyavuma ukuboshwa yile Mibandela Nemibandela. Uma ungavumelani nanoma yiyiphi ingxenye yale mibandela, awukwazi ukusebenzisa amasevisi ethu.

serviceDescription.title: 2. Incazelo Yesevisi
serviceDescription.content1: I-Tracify ihlinzeka ngesevisi yokulandelela indawo yocingo esekelwe emvumweni. Isevisi yethu isebenza ngokuthumela umlayezo we-SMS enombolweni yocingo oyinikezayo, ucela imvumo yomamukeli yokwabelana ngendawo yakhe.
serviceDescription.important: Okubalulekile: Ukulandelela indawo kwenzeka kuphela lapho umamukeli we-SMS evuma ngokusobala ukwabelana ngendawo yakhe. Asilandeleli ocingo ngaphandle kwemvumo esebenzayo yomnikazi.

billing.title: 3. Ukubhalisa I-akhawunti Nokubilwa
billing.content1: Ukuze usebenzise i-Tracify, kumele udale i-akhawunti futhi ubhalisele isevisi yethu. Isakhiwo sethu samanani simi kanje:
billing.monthly: Ukubhaliselwa kwenyanga: $30.00 USD (kukhokhelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo ngemva kokuphela kwesikhathi sokuhlola)
billing.content2: Ngokubhalisela, ugunyaza ukuthi sikhokhise indlela yakho yokukhokha njalo ngenyanga kuze kube uyakhansela ukubhaliselwa kwakho. Zonke izinkokhelo zisetshenzwa ngokuphepha nge-Stripe.

userResponsibilities.title: 4. Imithwalo Yomsebenzisi
userResponsibilities.item2: Ungazami ukulandelela abantu ngaphandle kwesizathu esisemthethweni
userResponsibilities.item3: Ungasebenzisi isevisi ukusola, ukuhlukumeza, noma noma yimuphi umsebenzi ongekho emthethweni
userResponsibilities.item4: Unikeze ulwazi oluyiqiniso lapho udala i-akhawunti yakho
userResponsibilities.item5: Ugcine imininingwane ye-akhawunti yakho iphephile neyimfihlo

prohibitedUses.title: 5. Ukusetshenziswa Okungavunyelwe
prohibitedUses.item1: Ukusola noma ukuhlukumeza noma yimuphi umuntu
prohibitedUses.item3: Noma yikuphi ukusetshenziswa okwephula imithetho yendawo, yesifundazwe, yesizwe, noma yamazwe ngamazwe

liability.title: 6. Ukuncishiswa Komthwalo
liability.content1: I-Tracify ihlinzeka ngamasevisi ayo "njengoba enjalo" ngaphandle kweziqinisekiso zanoma yiluphi uhlobo. Asizithwali umthwalo ngalokhu:
liability.item3: Noma yikuphi ukusetshenziswa kabi kwesevisi ngabasebenzisi
liability.item4: Izenzo ezithathwe ngokusekelwe olwazini lwendawo olutholakele
liability.content2: Isamba somthwalo wethu ngeke sedlule inani olikhokhe ngesevisi ngenyanga edlule noma yisiphi isicelo.

cancellation.title: 7. Inqubomgomo Yokukhansela Nokubuyiselwa Kwemali
cancellation.content1: Ungakhansela ukubhaliselwa kwakho noma nini ngekhasi lethu lokukhansela noma ngokuxhumana nethimba lethu lokusekela. Lapho kukhansela:
cancellation.item2: Akukho ezinye izimali ezizokwenziwa ku-akhawunti yakho
cancellation.item3: Ukubuyiselwa kwemali ngokuvamile akuhlinzekwa ngezinyanga ezingaphelele
cancellation.content2: Ngezimpikiswano zokubilwa noma izicelo zokubuyiselwa kwemali, sicela uxhumane ne-support@tracify-geo.com.

modifications.title: 8. Ukuguqulwa Kwemibandela
modifications.content: Sigodla ilungelo lokushintsha le Mibandela Nemibandela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Izinguquko zizosebenza ngokushesha lapho zifakwa kuwebhusayithi yethu. Ukuqhubeka kwakho ukusebenzisa i-Tracify ngemva kwezinguquko kusho ukwamukela imibandela eguquliwe.

governingLaw.title: 9. Umthetho Olawulayo
governingLaw.content: Le Mibandela Nemibandela izolawulwa futhi ichazwe ngokuvumelana nemithetho esebenzayo. Noma yiziphi izimpikiswano ezivela kule mibandela zizoxazululwa ngemigudu efanele yezomthetho.

contact.title: 10. Ulwazi Lokuxhumana
contact.content: Uma unemibuzo mayelana nale Mibandela Nemibandela, sicela uxhumane nathi ku:

privacy.title: Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo
privacy.cardSubtitle: Sizibophezele ekuvikeleni ulwazi lwakho lomuntu siqu.

introduction.title: 1. Isingeniso
introduction.content: Le Nqubomgomo Yobumfihlo ichaza ukuthi i-Tracify ("thina", "kithi", noma "okwethu") iqoqa, isebenzisa, futhi ivikela kanjani ulwazi lwakho lomuntu siqu lapho usebenzisa iwebhusayithi yethu ku-tracify-geo.com kanye namasevisi ethu okulandelela indawo yocingo. Ngokusebenzisa amasevisi ethu, uyavuma izindlela zedatha ezichazwe kule nqubomgomo.

dataCollection.title: 2. Ulwazi Esiliqoqayo
dataCollection.item1: Ulwazi Lwe-akhawunti: Ikheli le-imeyli, igama, nephasiwedi lapho ubhalisa
dataCollection.item2: Ulwazi Lwenkokhelo: Imininingwane yekhadi lesikweletu esetshenzwa ngokuphepha nge-Stripe
dataCollection.item3: Izinombolo Zocingo: Izinombolo ozithumela ngezicelo zokulandelela indawo
dataCollection.item4: Idatha Yendawo: Izixhumanisi ze-GPS ezabelanwa abamukeli abavumayo
dataCollection.item5: Idatha Yokusetshenziswa: Indlela osebenzisana ngayo nesevisi yethu, kuhlanganise ikheli le-IP nohlobo lwebhrawuza

dataUse.title: 3. Indlela Esisebenzisa Ngayo Ulwazi Lwakho
dataUse.content: Sisebenzisa ulwazi lwakho ngalezi zinhloso ezilandelayo:
dataUse.item1: Ukuhlinzeka nokugcina isevisi yethu yokulandelela indawo
dataUse.item2: Ukusetshenzwa kwezinkokhelo zakho nokuphatha ukubhaliselwa kwakho
dataUse.item3: Ukuthumela izicelo zendawo ze-SMS ezinombolweni zocingo ozinikeza
dataUse.item4: Ukuxhumana nawe mayelana ne-akhawunti yakho nezibuyekezo zesevisi
dataUse.item5: Ukuthuthukisa amasevisi ethu nokuthuthukisa izici ezintsha

dataSharing.title: 4. Ukwabelana Ngedatha Nezinkampani Zangaphandle
dataSharing.content1: Asithengisi ulwazi lwakho lomuntu siqu. Singabelana ngedatha nalaba:
dataSharing.item1: I-Stripe: Umsetshenzisi wethu wenkokhelo, ukuphatha izinkokhelo ngokuphepha
dataSharing.item2: Abahlinzeki be-SMS: Ukuletha imilayezo yezicelo zendawo
dataSharing.item3: Iziphathimandla Zomthetho: Lapho kudingwa umthetho noma ukuvikela amalungelo ethu
dataSharing.content2: Bonke abahlinzeki bangaphandle baboshwe yisivumelwano ukuvikela idatha yakho.

dataSecurity.title: 5. Ukuphepha Kwedatha
dataSecurity.content: Sisebenzisa izinyathelo zokuphepha ezivamile embonini ukuvikela ulwazi lwakho:
dataSecurity.item1: Ukubethela kwe-SSL/TLS kukho konke ukudluliswa kwedatha
dataSecurity.item4: Ukufinyelela kwabasebenzi okulinganiselwe kudatha yomuntu siqu
dataSecurity.note: Qaphela: Nakuba sithatha izinyathelo eziningi, akukho ukudluliswa kwe-inthanethi okuphephile ngokuphelele. Asikwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha okuphelele.

userRights.title: 6. Amalungelo Akho
userRights.content: Unamalungelo alandelayo mayelana nedatha yakho yomuntu siqu:
userRights.item1: Ukufinyelela: Cela ikhophi yedatha yakho yomuntu siqu
userRights.item3: Ukusulwa: Cela ukususwa kwe-akhawunti yakho nedatha ehlobene
userRights.item4: Ukuthwala: Cela idatha yakho ngefomethi ethwalekayo
userRights.item5: Ukukhetha Ukuphuma: Susa ukubhaliselwa ezaziso zokukhangisa
userRights.contact: Ukusebenzisa la malungelo, xhumana nathi ku-support@tracify-geo.com.

cookies.title: 7. Amakhukhi Nokulandelela
cookies.content2: Ungalawula amakhukhi ngezilungiselelo zebhrawuza yakho. Ukuvimbela amakhukhi kungathinta ezinye izici zesevisi yethu.

dataRetention.title: 8. Ukugcinwa Kwedatha
dataRetention.content: Sigcina idatha yakho yomuntu siqu uma nje i-akhawunti yakho isasebenza noma njengoba kudingeka ukuhlinzeka ngamasevisi. Ngemva kokususwa kwe-akhawunti, singagcina idatha ethile ukuthobela umthetho, ukuxazulula izimpikiswano, noma izinhloso zebhizinisi ezisemthethweni kuze kube yizinsuku ezingu-90.

children.title: 9. Ubumfihlo Bezingane
children.content: I-Tracify ayenzelwe ukusetshenziswa abantu abangaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18 ubudala. Asiqoqi ulwazi lomuntu siqu ezinganeni ngamabomu. Uma sithola ukuthi ingane isinikeze ulwazi lomuntu siqu, sizolisusa ngokushesha.

changes.title: 10. Izinguquko Kule Nqubomgomo
changes.content: Singabuyekeza le Nqubomgomo Yobumfihlo ngezikhathi ezithile. Sizokwazisa ngezinguquko ezibalulekile ngokufaka inqubomgomo entsha kuwebhusayithi yethu nokubuyekeza usuku lwe-"Kubuyekezwe Ekugcineni". Ukuqhubeka kwakho ukusebenzisa amasevisi ethu ngemva kwezinguquko kusho ukwamukela.

contact.title: 11. Xhumana Nathi
contact.content: Uma unemibuzo noma ukukhathazeka ngale Nqubomgomo Yobumfihlo noma izindlela zethu zedatha, sicela uxhumane nathi:

signup.title: Faka i-imeyili yakho
signup.subtitle: Sizothumela iphasiwedi ye-akhawunti yakho kule kheli le-imeyili.
signup.agreeText: Ngiyavuma ukuthola ama-imeyili okukhangisa nezibuyekezo ezivela ku-Tracify
